title: Aula F75 Ultra sheet
blurb: VIA plus onboard FN. FN+Q / W / E switch Android / Windows / Mac (key blinks red 3s). Not the same FN map as the QK108.
footer: Ultra quick-start: FN+\ effects, FN+Tab color, FN+Backspace lights, FN+B battery. VIA JSON from Epomaker/Aula. VID fffe:00a9.

groups.label: RGB
groups.hint: 18 onboard effects — no Windows app needed

groups.label: System
groups.hint: OS swap, Win lock, factory reset

combos.title: Open VIA
combos.detail: Epomaker x Aula F75 Ultra. USB-C (not Bluetooth). via-browser-connect lists it as fffe:00a9. Distro Chromium → usevia.app.

combos.title: Android
combos.detail: Q blinks red for 3 seconds. Confirmed on the F75 Ultra quick-start and Aula F75 manuals. Makes the F-row match the OS.

combos.title: Windows
combos.detail: W blinks red for 3 seconds. Confirmed. If Alt/Win feel swapped, you are in Mac mode — press this.

combos.title: Mac
combos.detail: E blinks red for 3 seconds. Confirmed. Swaps left Win/Alt to Cmd/Option.

combos.title: Win lock
combos.detail: Confirmed. Indicator stays on while locked. Mac mode ignores this.

combos.title: Factory reset
combos.detail: Ultra quick-start: hold FN+Esc 3s. Older Aula F75 sheets say 5s. Bluetooth pairings are kept. Board returns to default parameters.

combos.title: Battery check
combos.detail: Confirmed. Hold FN+B (press also works on some firmware). Keys 1–0 light green for remaining capacity; more keys = more battery. Below ~30% goes red. Does nothing while wired/charging.

combos.title: Bluetooth 1
combos.detail: Toggle the side switch to BT. Hold until it flashes fast. Short press reconnects.

combos.title: Bluetooth 2
combos.detail: Same as slot 1.

combos.title: Bluetooth 3
combos.detail: Same as slot 1.

combos.title: 2.4 GHz
combos.detail: Side switch to 2.4G. FN+~ until it flashes, then plug the dongle.

combos.title: Cycle 17 effects
combos.detail: Confirmed on the Ultra listing and quick-start as FN+\ / FN+|. Original Aula F75 also maps FN+PrtSc to the same 17-preset loop — try PrtSc if | does nothing after a VIA remap.

combos.title: Cycle effects (alt)
combos.detail: On the non-Ultra F75 and some listings. Ultra official table uses FN+\ instead.

combos.title: Solid colors
combos.detail: Confirmed: FN+Tab cycles single-color filters while an effect is active. Ultra/Amazon say press, not hold. Hold if tap does nothing on your firmware.

combos.title: Brightness up
combos.detail: Confirmed. Caps blinks at the top stop.

combos.title: Brightness down
combos.detail: Confirmed. Keep tapping to dim.

combos.title: Lights on / off
combos.detail: Ultra quick-start and Amazon: FN+Backspace. Some regional listings say hold FN+Space — that is not in the Ultra table; use Backspace first, Space only if your unit matches that sheet.

combos.title: Speed −
combos.detail: Confirmed. Caps blinks at the slowest step.

combos.title: Speed +
combos.detail: Confirmed.

combos.title: Side strip effects
combos.detail: Ultra quick-start only: cycles the case light bar, separate from the keycaps.

lightsOut.copy: FN+Backspace toggles lights. FN+↓ dims. FN+| cycles 17 effects.

steps: Load Epomaker × Aula F75 Ultra JSON if the Design tab is empty.
